name: Google International Digital Exchange Port / Digital Exchange Hub
notes: Official Dominican presidency announcement says Google will establish an open, neutral international digital exchange port in the Dominican Republic, with submarine cable systems and a facility for AI-related data flow/processing; follow-up presidency remarks cite more than USD 500M investment and a world-class data hub. Location within the country is not specified beyond national/Santo Domingo announcement context, so assigned to Santo Domingo division with capacity unknown.

name: KIO SDO | 1
notes: KIO official location page lists an operating Tier IV-design, carrier-neutral data center at Free Trade Zone Las Americas in Santo Domingo with 2N electrical systems, hurricane-resistant construction, 223 sq m data hall, two 275 kVA UPS units, and two 450 kW generators. Uptime Institute lists KIO/DOM in Santo Domingo Este.

name: NAPCaribe Data Center
notes: NAPCaribe and Data Center Map identify a data center at Parque Cibernetico de Santo Domingo / Autopista Las Americas in Santo Domingo Este, serving as a neutral interconnection hub with colocation, disaster recovery, business continuity, and 24/7 operations. Capacity not published.

name: Torre Popular Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists Torre Popular Data Center at Torre Popular, Avenida John F. Kennedy, Santo Domingo, operated with NAPCaribe support for Banco Popular mission-critical financial services; listed as Tier 3 with private/partial cabinets and cloud services. Capacity not published.

name: Centro de Datos del Estado Dominicano / Data Center del Estado
notes: OGTIC official pages document government announcement and 2018 commissioning of the Dominican State Data Center at/for the Parque Cibernetico de Santo Domingo, supporting Republica Digital government hosting and services; DCD also reported the 2018 inauguration. Capacity not published.
